# Apache ECharts

`echarts-5.6.0.min.js` is copied unchanged from the `dist/echarts.min.js` file
in the official npm package `echarts@5.6.0`.

Source: https://www.npmjs.com/package/echarts/v/5.6.0

The Apache 2.0 license and upstream NOTICE are included alongside the library.
The GDP page loads this local copy only; no CDN or runtime data API is needed.
